headlines.text: It was 2023 when MJF vs. Jack Perry vs. Darby Allin vs. Sammy Guevara clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.83 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. For Jack Perry, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. MJF revived his headlock finisher to pin an unconscious Darby Allin, retaining the AEW World Title over Allin, Sammy Guevara and Jack Perry in the first-ever four-way for the belt.

Flash back to 2025, when Gabe Kidd competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Jon Moxley vs. Marina Shafir vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Mike Bailey vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.51 ? a well-worked match. Gabe Kidd debuted alongside the Death Riders, helping Jon Moxley and Marina Shafir overpower Willow Nightingale, Mark Briscoe and Mike Bailey.
Flash back to 2021, when Evil Uno made their return to AEW television after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On a Sunday in 2023, back when Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. The Elite vs. The Young Bucks vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Kenny Omega vs. Adam Page settled things in an Anarchy in the Arena match, closing out the card as the main event on Double or Nothing, rated 8.74 ? a match fans still talk about ? part of that year's Double or Nothing '23. In a rematch of the previous year's chaotic brawl, Blackpool Combat Club overcame The Elite in Anarchy in the Arena when Moxley choked out Kenny Omega with a bulldog choke, a match that also revealed Konosuke Takeshita's heel turn to align with Don Callis.

Flash back to 2023, when Wardlow vs. Christian Cage fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title in a Ladder match, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 6.71. This stood as the 70th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a real piece of championship history. Wardlow retained the TNT Championship in a ladder match after Arn Anderson tipped the ladder Christian Cage was climbing, sending him falling right into a powerbomb.

2023 brought us this moment: FTR vs. Jarrett & Lethal went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 6.36. It marked FTR's 10th match with the title on the line.
